brief.title: Discovery workshop — Outpatient appointment scheduling — 3 Feb 2026
business_goals: Patients need to be able to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments online.
Online booking should show real-time availability per clinician, not just per clinic — some of our consultants split time across two sites.

Any patient record has to pull from our NHS Spine lookup to confirm the NHS number before the first appointment is confirmed — we can't have a booking without a verified NHS number, that's a hard requirement from the trust.
Appointment data needs to sync with EMIS both ways — a booking made online should show in EMIS, and if a clinician blocks time in EMIS, it should disappear from the online slots.
constraints: Across our nine clinics we still book appointments over the phone into a shared paper diary at each site, and double-bookings happen most weeks.
Under UK GDPR, patient data has to stay within the UK, and we need an audit trail of who viewed which patient record and when — that's something our last CQC inspection specifically asked about.
We've been told this needs to go live before the new financial year starts in April, and the board has capped the budget at £180,000 for this phase.
open_questions: Which metric defines success for launch?
